title: Tone of the news, 1945-2010
book_page: Supplemental Graphics page 1 (text-indexed; local PDF page unavailable)
claim_summary: NYT and international news coverage became more negative over the periods shown.
book_citation: Leetaru 2011; resolved to First Monday 16(9), doi:10.5210/fm.v16i9.3663
original_dataset: Unpublished monthly standardized tone aggregates derived from licensed NYT and SWB corpora
archive_url: Former ICHASS host searched; GDELT preserves author-supplied figures only
notes: Original article and component plots recovered, but monthly values, code, and exact final sentiment configuration were not published or recovered. No reconstruction, digitization, or extension was made.

title: Oil spills, 1970-2016
claim_summary: Oil spills declined while oil shipped by sea increased.
book_citation: Book source line confirmed from Kindle and public figure excerpts; see figures/10-5/source_logs/source_log.md.
original_dataset: ITOPF/Roser spill-count data plus unresolved annual UNCTADStat/ITOPF oil-shipped-by-sea series
notes: Spill-count line is supported and plotted. Current UNCTADStat bulk successor was recovered but starts in 2000 and fails RMT scale validation, so the book gray line is not plotted and the figure remains partial.

title: Protected areas, 1990-2014
claim_summary: Terrestrial and marine protected areas increased during the book period.
book_citation: Book source line confirmed from Kindle during proof of concept; see figures/10-6/source_logs/source_log.md.
original_dataset: World Bank World Development Indicators archived bulk CSV
notes: Archived WDI 2017 release reproduces book-period anchor values closely; post-2014 current WDI extension is a successor series with a documented marine discontinuity.

title: Carbon intensity (CO2 emissions per dollar of GDP), 1820-2014
claim_summary: Surrounding chapter text discusses decarbonization, carbon intensity, and the claim that rich countries can reduce carbon emissions per dollar of GDP after industrialization.
book_citation: Ritchie & Roser 2017, based on data from CDIAC; GDP in 2011 international dollars with pre-1990 GDP from Maddison Project 2014.
original_dataset: OWID datasets: Carbon intensity (kgCO2/$) - Madisson, World Bank, CDIAC
notes: Minor typography and label-placement differences remain.; Current OWID successor data revise historical values substantially, so only post-2014 dashed segments are used in the extension.

title: CO2 emissions, 1960-2015
claim_summary: Surrounding chapter text argues that global emissions plateaued around 2014-2015, with changes in China, the EU, and the United States.
book_citation: Our World in Data, Ritchie & Roser 2017, the OWID annual CO2 emissions by region grapher, CDIAC, and Le Quere et al. 2016; international air and sea corresponds to bunker fuels, and Other corresponds to statistical difference.
original_dataset: OWID datasets: CO2 per year by region - CDIAC (2017)
notes: Layer labels and font styling are approximate.; Post-2015 extension uses current GCB/OWID successor categories, including EU-27 instead of EU-28 and no directly comparable statistical-difference layer.

title: Life expectancy, 1771-2015
claim_summary: Average life expectancy increased across world regions from the Enlightenment era to 2015.
book_citation: Our World in Data, Roser 2016n, based on Riley 2005 before 2000 and WHO/World Bank after.
dataset_url: local OWID datasets mirror; current extension https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/life-expectancy.csv
archive_url: See figure source log; archival source search remains documented there.
notes: Remediated on 2026-06-29: verified book-period reconstruction; extended artifact intentionally plots no post-2015 successor segment because no comparable regional extension was accepted.

notes: Recovered immutable CME Info 2016 component but not full UN/HMD assembly; plot clips current successor values to book-visible starts and does not plot a post-2013 extension.
